name: boiler-snake
description: Boiler Snake: XP + leveling + roles with per-guild settings.

scripts.test: npm run assets:build && node --require ./test/helpers/test-env-guard.js --test test/*.test.js test/integration/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run assets:build && node --require ./test/helpers/test-env-guard.js --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**' --test-coverage-exclude='test/**' --test-coverage-exclude='scripts/**' --test-coverage-exclude='node_modules/**' --test-coverage-lines=88 --test-coverage-branches=76 --test-coverage-functions=87 test/*.test.js test/integration/*.test.js

//: test:coverage = Node's built-in runner coverage (no deps) over src/ for BOTH suites in one run; include/exclude keep src/ only in the report. Threshold flags check OVERALL totals (node exits 1 when unmet). Gate raised 2026-10-11 (audit issue #203) from the stale 77/67/77 to 88/76/87. Re-measured 2026-10-19 (#470 G2-8) on the full corpus: all files lines 89.60%, branches 77.61%, funcs 88.68% — margins 1.6/1.6/1.7pt. Re-measured 2026-10-27 (#710, local Node 26): all files lines 90.40%, branches 78.41%, funcs 89.53% — margins 2.40/2.41/2.53pt. CI enforces the gate on the Node 22.x leg of .github/workflows/test.yml (V8 versions can shift totals a little). TIE-BREAKER (#470 G2-8): the gate may only move DOWN when an A/B run proves the drop is instrumentation/V8 drift — run BOTH the merge-base commit and the change on the SAME Node; a coverage regression is fixed by raising coverage, never by lowering the gate to accommodate it (this sentence now decides; it supersedes the old 'actuals-minus-3' re-baseline style, which could be followed while masking a regression). Update the measured actuals here whenever this note is touched. Team targets are critical-paths 100% / high 90%+ (standards) — raise thresholds as coverage improves.
